title: Capturing Their Hearts, The Name Is――

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kyu-kyu～☆ Anime film 『Kyumaru and Seaside
Kingdom』 screening to rave reviews!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
After getting lost at sea,
Kyumaru and friends embark on brand new
adventure——Everyone, dying to know more,
right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Grand adventure packed with love and
courage!
Join Ai for wonderful time at theater♪

text_block_list.name: Trendy Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really her!
Ai-chan super cute! Insane aura～!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan, saw that commercial～!
Made me wanna see movie too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
thank you! Please keep cheering me on!

Won pair of Kyumaru plushies in quiz contest
earlier. Caught top exec's eye,
asked to help promote film——
choice_data_list: Must be hard to relax with all tha...
Must be hard to relax with all tha...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Makes me happy, though.
More attention and expectations,
more fired up I get!

Ah, so dependable!
Truly, had to ask you……!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Um……nice meeting you.
Who might you be?

text_block_list.name: Summer Festival Planner
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Summer Festival coordinator here……
Here is my card.

text_block_list.name: Summer Festival Planner
text_block_list.text:
Truth is,
idol planned for next week's Live fell
ill——

text_block_list.name: Summer Festival Planner
text_block_list.text:
Then Ai-san, rising fast in popularity,
appeared! We desperately need your help……!
Begging you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Substitute for Summer Live, right?
——Thank you for wonderful chance.
Sounds thrilling!

Still,
girls were mid critical summer training camp.
Sudden gig meant heavy burden——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Okay if I accept?

Seeing those sparkling eyes,
impossible to stop her——No,
didn't want to. Decided instantly.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah…… Trainer,
revised menu feels solid!
Can push harder, though!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Got that late-night draft ready, right?
Might as well run entire thing!
choice_data_list: You saw that, huh……Okay, let's do it!
You saw that, huh……Okay, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Vital summer camp,
gotta train leave zero regrets!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah～ah～ah～ah～ah～♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Singing out loud with scenery like this
feels amazing. Super refreshing,
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why not sing along?
Got chorus section need to practice.

Bit embarrassing honestly.
Doubted I could match Almond Eye's harmony,
but——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's spirit! Let's hit it!
——Toward place once felt so far～♪
choice_data_list: With a little push on the back

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: All memories we built together～♪
choice_data_list: Never let the moment slip away

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Heartbeats flutter wild with joy
Uncontainable, unstoppable
Surge of burning passion never fades～♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: YOU AND I!

Summer camp drills and live stage prep——
Held nothing back on either.
Poured everything into both.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Hydration already handled.
Cucumbers plus sports drink, fully good!
choice_data_list: Good, just watch out for heatstroke
Good, just watch out for heatstroke

text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye sweated little,
trapping body heat post-workout.
Summer demanded extra vigilance——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry,
doing fine so far! Pleasant mild exhaustion,
you know? Super fulfilling.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Camp results guaranteed like this!
And for Live, I'll deliver top performance,
watch!
choice_data_list: Yeah, just one final push then!!
Yeah, just one final push then!!

text_block_list.text:
Another packed,
fulfilling day alongside Almond Eye——
Wished it would last forever.
Then, day of Live——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh oh oh……Oh oh ohhh——!
Oh oh oh……Oh oh ohhh——!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(——Going great, just as planned!
Singing full power from chest——)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Gonna light everyone up……!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah～!
So cute yet cool……Ai-chan unbeatable,
right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Sparkle blinding～! Can't look away……!

Single glance captivated crowd.
Dazzling Almond Eye set to take world by
storm——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Don't stop! No, don't stop 'til finish!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you for today!
Seeing all your smiles brings pure joy!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer……yeah. Training camp, Live prep,
we tackled everything full throttle)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Had total blast-!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Mmm～! Real sense of accomplishment, huh?
choice_data_list: The Live was a huge success!
The Live was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Live was massive success!
……Thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Normally,
you'd demand camp focus——Or stop me altogether.
Yet you matched my stride.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Truly, peak Trainer behavior!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ——Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So many more challenges I wanna tackle
together.
Just like this, bound to be thrilling!
choice_data_list: Right……With you, I'm ready for any...
Right……With you, I'm ready for any...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right? Exactly!
Once back at academy,
let's find next challenge!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Something firing us both up,
something massive!
Once chosen——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: We conquer it, guaranteed!
